answer: Each identity may endorse only 9 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 361 aliases need 361 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The beacon of the design is public, the crystal of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the nectar of honest work is what finally pays.
